meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Tencent QQ portal (qq.com): hide the client download button, banner slots, products and quotes; blur or hide news pictures.
meta.notes:
Checked 2026-11-13, logged out, headless Chrome over CDP with a desktop UA (1440x900) on www.qq.com/. Not captured: an iPhone-UA page (QQ sends phones to a different mobile portal and Chrome/network were out of memory when retried), article pages (news.qq.com, new.qq.com), v.qq.com video.

LIVE counts on Home: download-btn desktop home 2; banner-slots desktop home 2; pics-blur desktop home 114; pics-hide desktop home 114; hot-video desktop home 1; stock-rows desktop home 9; product-area desktop home 1. Selectors use the `qqhome-*` ids (module wrappers), the readable `stock-row` and `home-download-btn` classes; the rest of the portal uses hashed classes that are not used. The banner slots (`#qqhome-top-banner`, `#qqhome-china-medal`) were empty placeholders when captured; they are the ad / campaign slots and the rule hides them when filled (INFERRED).

Choice: News pictures Show/Blur/Hide (blur 10px) on the feed and hot-picks images; the feed container `#qqhome-channel-feed` is never hidden. Log in (`#qqcom-login`) and search (`#search-regular`) are kept.

NOT verified: phone portal, article pages, whether the product block is an ad slot or a static module, WeChat links. All visible text is Chinese; no text matching is used.
